A mysterious saddle made with forgotten ancient technology. Equip a horse with this and use {{Icon|BotW D-Pad Down}} to call them even when they are far away.|Inventory|BotW}} It is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] pack. ==Location and Uses== The Ancient Saddle is a [[Saddle]] made from [[Sheikah]] [[Ancient Technology]], and it is a piece of [[Ancient Horse Gear]]. When {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack is active, [[Link]] will receive the "[[EX Ancient Horse Rumors]]" [[Side Quest]], which instructs him to read the copy of ''[[Super Rumor Mill EX]]'' at [[Highland Stable]].{{Cite|Apparently {{Color BotW|Red|Highland Stable}} has a copy of Super Rumor Mill EX, which details some rumors about this rare horse gear.|Adventure Log|BotW}} There, Link can read ''[[Super Rumor Mill V3]]'', which explains that the Ancient Saddle is found at a spring where a [[Horse]] spirit resides.{{Cite|The saddle is {{Color BotW|Red|at a mysterious spring where a horse spirit resides}}.|Super Rumor Mill V3|BotW}} Afterwards, Link can find the Saddle inside a metal EX [[Treasure Chest]] that is embedded in the ground at [[Malanya Spring]]. Link can equip the Ancient Saddle to his Horses by talking to workers at Highland Stable, [[Outskirt Stable]], [[South Akkala Stable]], or [[Woodland Stable]].{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Ancient Saddle}}?|Canni|BotW}} When equipped, [[Link]] is capable of [[Whistle|Whistling]] to [[Warping|Warp]] his Horse nearly anywhere that a Horse can be present, even if the Horse is out of earshot and would not be able to run to Link's location. As with other [[Saddle]]s, the Ancient Saddle cannot be equipped to [[Epona]] or the [[Giant Horse]].{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty fine horse you have there.
